name: monorepo
description: Multiple apps and/or services in one repo. Each app/service is independently scoped. coding-fe may be spawned once per FE app; coding-be once per BE service.
notes: When tasks target a specific app/service, the architecture agent should narrow ownership in the per-feature team_plan.json — e.g. `coding-be: ["services/auth/**"]` for a feature scoped to one service.
